verdict.rationale: A runtime probe found that kimi.com publishes no llms.txt: the URL redirects to the SPA root, and the assistant app has no docs site. The only llms.txt found is at platform.kimi.ai, which the vendor's own product-plans doc describes as the separate Kimi API Open Platform product. The Kimi Code docs can be fetched without a key, but nothing shows them as an llms.txt index or agent-oriented docs for this product.
